test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Out of the five constraints in life that the Jains need to follow, which of the following means non-acquisition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aparigraha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rishabh Dev was the founder of Jainism.
 
• Mahavir Swami was the 24th and the last Tirthankara of Jainism.
 
• The founders of Jainism are known as Tirthankaras.
 
• Mahavir Swami was born in 540 BCE in Kundagram (Vaishali).
 
• At the age of 30 years, he adopted the life of an ascetic after the death of his parents.
 
• After meditating rigidly for 12 years, he attained knowledge. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Right knowledge, right faith, and right conduct are the three most essentials for attaining liberation in Jainism. In order to acquire these, one must observe the five great vows:

 
• Non-violence - Ahimsa
 
• Truth - Satya
 
• Non-stealing - Achaurya or Asteya
 
• Celibacy/Chastity - Brahmacharya
 
• Non-attachment/Non-possession/Non-acquisition- Aparigraha
